[P2] Validate probes against the earliest admission closure

For otherwise valid normal-return evidence, an `admission_closed` event at 36 and an `ACCEPTED` operation probe at 37 pass when `wrapper_return` is at 40 and later probes are rejected. Disposal passes 40 as `closed`, so this filter discards the accepted probe. `no_late_dispatch()` only checks SDK dispatches and cannot catch this admission violation. Use the earliest recorded closure when checking probe outcomes, and add a regression containing both closure events and an accepted probe between them.
